flags.why: Đàn bà does not itself mean that a woman is married and has children; those details come from có chồng có con in the example ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/đàn_bà)).
flags.fix: Remove sense 2 and retain the example under sense 1.

flags.why: Tranh means roofing thatch or cogon grass, rather than straw generally ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/tranh)).
Mặc dù is a normal conjunction used in everyday speech, so formal misleadingly restricts its use.
Ôm meaning an armful remains ordinary usage for things such as firewood and is not dated ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/ôm)).
The common use expressing extreme degree, as in nóng khủng khiếp, is missing ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-kh%E1%BB%A7ng%20khi%E1%BA%BFp)).
flags.fix: Add: adv | extremely; terribly; awfully (intensifier); example: Hôm nay trời nóng khủng khiếp. = It's terribly hot today.
